verdict.rationale: Polar's docs site serves date-versioned OpenAPI 3.1 specs (2026-04 and 2026-10) for its HTTP and Webhooks API, and refers to a versioned API reference, so API versioning is evidenced. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or migration guidance between versions. The probe 404s are at root-level OpenAPI paths and do not contradict the docs-hosted specs. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version-to-version migration and changelog guidance, independent corroboration of version stability.
